nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Circular economy practices|Product sharing platforms_qna_002
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What are Product Service Systems (PSS) in the context of collaborative consumption?
nodes.answer: Product Service Systems (PSS) are a form of collaborative consumption under the sharing economy concept, involving tangible products and intangible services designed to meet specific customer needs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Circular economy practices|Product sharing platforms_qna_003
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How does immediate decision-making based on information sharing benefit the retailer in the product development process?
nodes.answer: Immediate decisions based on information sharing, especially regarding product performance and sustainability-related information, help the retailer to acquire the right product at the right time and price, enhancing efficiency in the development process.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Circular economy practices|Product sharing platforms_qna_004
nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What do user-generated reviews on app-provision platforms like Google Play Store and Apple App Store help to understand?
nodes.answer: They help understand users' perceptions and feedback on the apps they use.

nodes.question: How many sectors and products are included in the SAM?
